```sql
WITH team_matches AS (
    SELECT team, COUNT(*) AS matches_played
    FROM (
        SELECT match_id, team1 AS team FROM matches
        UNION ALL
        SELECT match_id, team2 AS team FROM matches
    ) AS all_teams
    GROUP BY team
),
team_wins AS (
    SELECT winner AS team, COUNT(*) AS wins
    FROM matches
    WHERE winner IS NOT NULL AND winner <> ''
    GROUP BY winner
)
SELECT 
    tm.team,
    tm.matches_played,
    COALESCE(tw.wins, 0) AS wins,
    ROUND(COALESCE(tw.wins, 0)::numeric / tm.matches_played * 100, 2) AS win_percentage
FROM team_matches tm
LEFT JOIN team_wins tw ON tm.team = tw.team
WHERE tm.matches_played >= 50
ORDER BY win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
